edges.reason: Constructor reads _msgSender() to seed the deployer reflection balance and ownership.
transfer moves tokens from _msgSender().
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
unlock authorizes msg.sender against the stored _previousOwner before restoring ownership.
excludeFromFee is gated by onlyOwner which compares _owner with _msgSender().
includeInFee is gated by onlyOwner which compares _owner with _msgSender().
owner() exposes _owner that callers are checked against in access-controlled paths.
block.timestamp is used directly as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
lock() derives _lockTime from now, so the unlock window depends on miner-controlled time.
Constructor assigns the full _rTotal to the deployer in _rOwned.
Ownable constructor sets _owner to the deployer.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair address.
transfer forwards caller, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to bound non-owner transfers.
_transfer conditionally invokes swapAndLiquify, entering the external-call routine mid-transfer.
_transfer reads the inSwapAndLiquify guard before triggering a swap.
_transfer reads swapAndLiquifyEnabled to decide whether to swap.
_transfer compares the sender against uniswapV2Pair to avoid circular liquidity.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to size the liquidity trigger.
Dispatcher selects the standard transfer path when neither party is excluded.
Dispatcher selects the transfer-to-excluded path.
Dispatcher selects the transfer-from-excluded path.
Dispatcher selects the both-excluded path.
_tokenTransfer branches on the _isExcluded membership of both parties.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when the transfer is fee exempt.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-exempt transfer.
Standard transfer credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
Standard transfer applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
Standard transfer subtracts and adds _rOwned balances.
To-excluded transfer credits the team fee.
To-excluded transfer applies the reflection fee.
From-excluded transfer credits the team fee.
From-excluded transfer applies the reflection fee.
Both-excluded transfer credits the team fee.
Both-excluded transfer applies the reflection fee.
_takeTeam credits the accumulated team fee to _teamWallet.
_takeTeam adds reflection units to _rOwned[_teamWallet].
_takeTeam also credits _tOwned when the team wallet is reward-excluded.
_reflectFee reduces the total reflection supply.
_reflectFee accumulates the real fee in _tFeeTotal.
_getValues calls _getTValues to derive real fee portions.
_getValues calls _getRValues to derive reflection portions.
_getValues obtains the current rate via _getRate.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply before dividing.
_getCurrentSupply iterates the _excluded array.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rOwned of excluded accounts.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tOwned of excluded accounts.
_getCurrentSupply starts from and can return _rTotal.
_getCurrentSupply starts from and can return _tTotal.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens through swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify deposits the remaining half plus ETH via addLiquidity.
The lockTheSwap modifier sets inSwapAndLiquify around the routine.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs the external value-bearing router call.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router address.
addLiquidity reads the uniswapV2Router address.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
addLiquidity approves the router before depositing.
addLiquidity sends the LP tokens to owner().
deliver subtracts reflection units from the caller's _rOwned.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the burned reflection amount.
deliver increases _tFeeTotal by the delivered token amount.
unlock reads _previousOwner for the authorization check and ownership restore.
unlock writes _owner back to the previous owner.
unlock reads _lockTime to enforce the lock expiry.
lock() computes now + time without overflow protection.
lock() zeroes _owner while preserving it as _previousOwner.
lock() records the current owner in _previousOwner.
lock() writes the future unlock timestamp to _lockTime.
setTaxFeePercent writes _taxFee without bounds.
setLiquidityFeePercent writes _teamFee without bounds.
setMaxTx writes _maxTxAmount.
setNumTokensSellToAddToLiquidity writes the swap threshold.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes the swap toggle.
excludeFromReward sets _isExcluded[account].
excludeFromReward pushes the account onto _excluded.
excludeFromReward snapshots the converted balance into _tOwned.
includeInReward mutates and pops the _excluded array.
includeInReward clears _isExcluded for the account.
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
_getTValues computes the tax portion via calculateTaxFee.
_getTValues computes the team portion via calculateTeamFee.
calculateTaxFee reads _taxFee.
calculateTeamFee reads _teamFee.
removeAllFee snapshots and zeroes _taxFee.
removeAllFee zeroes _teamFee.
removeAllFee stores _taxFee into _previousTaxFee.
restoreAllFee restores _taxFee from _previousTaxFee.
restoreAllFee restores _teamFee from _previousTeamFee.
balanceOf converts reflection balances through tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf reads _rOwned for non-excluded accounts.
balanceOf reads _tOwned for reward-excluded accounts.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate for the conversion.
tokenFromReflection validates the input against _rTotal.
The external Uniswap swap can transfer control to attacker-influenced contracts that re-enter transfer/_transfer while balances are mid-update.
The external addLiquidityETH call and the payable receive() give an external contract the chance to re-enter token transfer logic.

swapAndLiquify derives half of the contract token balance.

_transfer derives the takeFee flag from the fee-exempt mapping.
swapTokensForEth builds the [token, WETH] swap path.
